title: Minimalistic-Alarm-Clock
subtitle: A compact 4-key alarm clock built around a Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3
description: A digital alarm clock with a TFT screen, passive buzzer, four mechanical switches, and an angled display.

content.heading: About the Alarm Clock
content.text: This is a compact alarm clock designed around the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3. It has four MX-style keys and was made to support a modern digital-detox alarm clock.

content.heading: Open Source
content.text: The repository includes the CAD, PCB, production, and clock firmware files.
